turns.question: Which day had the highest revenue in October 2026, and how much was it?
turns.answer: The highest-revenue day in October 2026 (1-31 October) was 1 October 2026, with revenue of 981.69 EUR (non-cancelled orders). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
